detail: SHIP-BLOCKER examples/platformer/src/engine/records.ts:24-29 accepts any truthy best value and any numeric unlockedLevel as valid schema-v1 progress. Corrupt but parseable JSON such as best='oops' reaches progress.best[key] assignment and throws on level completion; extreme/non-finite unlockedLevel can also make Array.from fail. Validate finite bounded integers, a plain best object, and each record's numeric fields before exposing the data.
